agent_explanation: Body moves at ~53 m/s toward a thin horizontal wall (h=0.2). In step 0 distance_to_surface=0.56, step1 almost touching 0.023 with 22 substeps, but step2 penetrates -0.228 (>0.15 limit) because the collision with the thin edge/corner is missed under large dt (0.012) despite substepping. Substep displacement ~0.028m is small but the swept test vs AABB corner fails for grazing high-speed approach, allowing tunneling through the top edge area and then deep penetration. Reducing speed or dt removes violation.
